ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" = "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" ]; then exit 1; fi; prev="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}"; git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${prev}^{commit}" >/dev/null || exit 1; code=0; git diff --quiet "$prev" HEAD -- . ../../convex ../../packages ../../package.json ../../bun.lock || code=$?; if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; exit 1
